note:
COE campground on Lake Cumberland in south-central Kentucky.  About 14 of 30 sites are directly on the lakeshore.  --AWH
Shaded hardwood sites on a point over the main lake, with a boat ramp, a beach area and a playground. The Corps warns that the entrance and exit roads have a moderate to severe grade. --Claude
summary: Kept. USACE Lake Cumberland, 30 sites (29 Standard Electric 50A + water, 1 tent-electric), all back-in; $26 flat; flush toilets, showers, water, dump; season May 13 - Sep 19 (2027). The --AWH lakefront value is unchanged; DEM puts the closest pads 9-12 m above summer pool, so it reads as lakeview by the current rules (reported only). Phone added. The Corps warns of a moderate-to-severe entrance grade (flag, not a drop).
flags: WATERFRONT (--AWH lakefront, NOT changed; report only). rec.gov: 'Fourteen of these sites are waterfront'. Our rules read it lower. The south-loop pads closest to the water, site 10 (36.965265,-84.840304) and site 11 (36.965105,-84.840933), sit at 232.8 m and 229.8 m. That is 9-12 m above the 723-ft (220.4 m) summer pool, which they reach in ~31-33 m down a ~20 deg wooded slope under continuous canopy. The north-loop pads (e.g. 14 at 36.966651,-84.839502) are 28-32 m above and 50-80 m back. That fails the kayak test (pads 1-2 m above the edge) and would rate lakeview, not lakefront. AWH's firsthand value stands.

ACCESS: rec.gov: 'The entrance and exit roads have a moderate to severe grade.' This is not a 4WD/high-clearance requirement or a 'motorhomes/trailers not recommended' statement, so it is a flag, not a drop. The Corps' warning is in the note.
FACILITIES added: flush toilets, showers, drinking water, dump (rec.gov).
PIN 36.9662,-84.8400 lies inside the site loops (sites at 36.9651-36.9667, -84.8394 to -84.8409). rec.gov's 36.9655556,-84.8422222 is ~200 m west at the day-use/group-shelter end. Keep stored.
